name: wordmark and tagline end card on a soft colour bloom
looks: A small mark and the wordmark settle above centre on a plain field with a soft, colourful bloom glowing low in the corner. A one-line tagline fades in underneath, its last word picked out in a bright accent colour.
build: Mark and wordmark fade/scale in together; the bloom is a soft radial gradient, low opacity, pulsing gently; the tagline fades/rises 4-6px in, with its final word's colour swapped to the accent the instant it lands.
sound: A soft confirm tone as the mark settles, the bed fading out under the hold.
prompt: Close on a small mark and wordmark settling above centre over a soft colour bloom low in the corner, with a one-line tagline fading in underneath and its last word landing in a bright accent colour; hold the finished card.
